title: MedievalSMP
description: MedievalSMP is an experimental PVP-oriented, Semi-Anarchy, Vanilla+ SMP server with no game-altering gimmicks that most modern SMPs force upon every player - online 24/7.
body:
⭐ MedievalSMP is an **experimental PVP-oriented, Semi-Anarchy, Vanilla+ SMP server** with no game-altering gimmicks that most modern SMPs force upon every player - online 24/7

❓ What does experimental mean? **It means we constantly try new things with each reset** (so it won't feel repetitive), and ask for community feedback; **your voices are and always will be heard.**

✅ Our vanilla experience is enhanced with various QoL changes that normal vanilla Minecraft does not have. Such as:
- Homes
- Nations
- Graves
- TPA and /back commands
- Combat-log prevention
- Voice chat
- Multi-version support (1.16 - 26.X)
...and more that are constantly being added and improved!

🔥 MedievalSMP is Semi-Anarchy, which means griefing and stealing are totally allowed- encouraged, even! Alongside our improvements, our Nations plugin allows you and your friends to team up and wage war against existing nations. You create your story, all on your own terms.

For the less competitive players, we foster a welcoming community and host numerous types of community events that everyone can be a part of, so no one will feel left out.

Looking forward to putting your PVP and survival skills to the test? Join us! 🫵 

No mods required, Java only. 🌏 
Whitelisting is required.

Join now: https://discord.gg/euMJTTrT3r
